publishConsent.description: The member's own decision on trust-registry publication: `true` consents to the community publishing their membership in its trust registry, `false` withdraws that consent. Applies to the member who signed the document, and to no one else.

Response.title: VTC Members Registry Consent — response payload

did.description: The member whose consent this is: the document's signer.

publishConsent.description: The consent now recorded on the member record.

changed.description: Whether this document changed the recorded consent. `false` when the member restated the value already recorded.

registrySync.description: What the community did about its trust registry. `queued`: a registry sync job carrying the change is queued (publication on a grant, removal on a withdrawal). `notConfigured`: the community publishes to no trust registry at present; the consent is recorded and governs any registry configured later. `unchanged`: nothing to sync, because the consent did not change, or because the community does not publish this member on other grounds (consent permits publication; it does not oblige it).

effectiveAt.description: When the community recorded the consent now in force — this document's execution when `changed` is `true`, the earlier change otherwise.
